mapper.sql: id, user_id, format, start_date, end_date, photo_count, file_path, file_size, status, options, created_at, completed_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO export_record (user_id, format, start_date, end_date, photo_count, status, options, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{format}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{photoCount}, 'pending', #{options}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT FROM export_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE export_record SET status = 'completed', file_path = #{filePath}, file_size = #{fileSize}, completed_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM export_record WHERE (status = 'completed' AND completed_at IS NOT NULL AND completed_at < #{deadline}) OR (status = 'failed' AND created_at < #{deadline})
